content.comment_body: Hello, I'm currently working with [version_no] controllers and am wondering if there are any CPUs available with a built-in Profibus port, or if a separate Profibus module is required. Is similar functionality available for [product_name] controllers? Regards, [user_name]

Hello again, As far as I know, [product_name] does not support Profibus communication. However, you can use it as an ASI slave with CP or install a KNX/EIB CP for communication. You may find answers by joining the [product_name] user forum. Best regards.

Hi [user_name], Consider looking into AS-Interface networks. For [version_no] controllers, a CP243-2 or DP/AS-I Link 20 E is needed; on the [product_name] side, use a CM ASi interface. Note that the [product_name] AS-interface module requires 4 inputs and 4 outputs within its address area. Hope this helps. Best regards, [user_name]
Hi, Regarding AS-Interface, see [url] and for connecting AS-Interface to [product_name], see [url].
Hi [user_name], Please share your complete idea regarding Profibus communication. This will help the community provide better advice and address your actual problem, not just a part of it.

Hello everyone interested in Profibus for [product_name]: The only way is to combine [product_name] with a KNX/EIB module and then use a KNX to Profibus gateway from a third-party supplier. I'm not certain if [company_name]'s related division offers such a device, but these gateways exist for building automation, allowing KNX/EIB buses to interface with Profibus. This approach is quite costly and not ideal for [product_name] Profibus solutions. The ASi bus method is limited since [product_name] only acts as an ASi slave with 4 digital inputs and outputs. Using KNX to Profibus may allow some analog values and control. These are just my thoughts—nothing definite!

analysis.insight_summary: Members are exploring ways to achieve Profibus communication for [product_name] and [version_no] controllers. The consensus is that [product_name] does not have native Profibus capability, and solutions depend on extra modules (like ASi or KNX/EIB) or third-party gateways. These options are complex, expensive, and provide limited features such as acting only as an ASi slave with basic I/O functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping to achieve Profibus connectivity for [product_name] and [version_no] controllers in a simple and cost-effective way, ideally with built-in capabilities or easy-to-integrate modules.
